description: This file is a Perl script that sets up and runs a Catalyst web application server named 'Coocook'. It primarily serves as a launcher script for the Catalyst framework, configuring environment variables and invoking the Catalyst::ScriptRunner to start the server with specified options.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Method invoked to start the Catalyst server with the application name 'Coocook' and the server type 'Server'.
